parts.text: The IGCSE class is investigating the refraction of light through a transparent block. Fig. 4.1 shows a student’s ray trace sheet. It is not drawn full size. Fig. 4.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The student places a transparent block, largest face down, on a sheet of plain paper and draws the outline ABCD of the block. She removes the block and draws the normal NN' to side AB . She then draws the line EF at an angle of incidence i . On Fig. 4.1, measure the angle of incidence i . i = ........................................[1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) She places two pins P 1 and P 2 on line EF , as shown in Fig. 4.1, and replaces the block. She observes the images of P 1 and P 2 through side CD of the block so that the images of P 1 and P 2 appear one behind the other. She places two pins P 3 and P 4 between her eye and the block so that P 3 , P 4 and the images of P 1 and P 2 , seen through the block, appear one behind the other.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) On Fig. 4.1, draw a line joining the positions of P 3 and P 4 . Continue the line until it meets CD . Label this point H .

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Measure and record the length a of the line GH . a = ............................................

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Measure and record the length b of the line HF . b = ............................................

parts.label: v
parts.text: (v) Calculate the refractive index n of the material of the block using the equation n = b 2 a . n = ............................................ [5]

parts.label: i
parts.text: (c) (i) Suggest how far apart you would place the pins P 3 and P 4 if you were carrying out this experiment using a ray trace sheet the same size as this page. suggested distance = ............................................
